objective: abstaining bout-winner baseline (research bar, not a product model)
supportedOutputs: P(red wins) binary on COVERED bouts only
featureCutoff: prior decisive in-corpus bouts only; winner flags are the only outcome field captured (method/round not in this shape)
baseline: fighter Elo K=32 start 1500, decisive-only updates, no corner advantage (corners are listing order)

abstention.rules: either fighter <3 prior decisive in-corpus bouts OR idle >540 days
abstention.note: in-corpus-only history makes veterans with pre-2023 records look like debutants — coverage understates true knowability and is reported, not hidden

lastCardReplay.note: abstentions listed on the artifact with reasons

evaluation.split: chronological; first third of bouts warm-up (fit-only); walk-forward thereafter

marketComparison: unavailable — no authorized historical UFC odds capture exists
limitations: in-corpus history only: no pre-Aug-2023 records, no method/round data, no reach/age/stance
weak signal is the honest finding: 0.679 vs 0.691 prior over 289 covered bouts — a real but small edge over listing-order priors, nowhere near a usable fight model
draw/no-contest never predicted; replacements/late changes not modeled
publicActivation: OFF — founder decision; research readiness is not product activation
